resources.string: Touch and hold an icon, then drag it to another icon to reorder. Tap an app to move it to a folder; touch and hold a folder to manage it. Settings and App store stay at the end.
Touch and hold an icon, then drag it to another icon to reorder this folder. Tap an app to move it to the desktop or another folder.

Delete this folder? Its apps will return to the desktop. Apps and their data will be retained.

Each app can appear on the desktop or in one folder. Unchecking an existing member returns it to the desktop. Uninstalling retains its assigned location for reinstallation. Empty folders are hidden from the desktop.
Enter a folder name of 1 to 40 characters
The limit of 32 folders has been reached

Phone and tablet layouts are saved separately; the boundary is a smallest available device width of 600 dp. Defaults are 72 dp icons and 14 sp labels, with 3 icons per row on phones and 5 on tablets. Icons and column counts may shrink to fit the available space without overlapping.

Default order: Weather, Timetable, Status, Weather Maps, Astronomy, Earthquakes, Random draw, To-do, Music, Device Messaging, Color Vision Simulator. New folders follow the sortable items; App store and Settings stay last. Uninstalled apps are hidden, retaining their assigned locations.
